scope: Synchronous recursive CPU record and enum String fields

implementation.ownership: Iterative inline-field enumeration validates active String descriptors and retains allocated buffers as recursive node dependencies; no buffer copy during boxing
implementation.inactive: Inactive enum String fields are not inspected or retained; canonical empty Strings contribute no backing
implementation.failure: Private checked runtime bridge validates owned base, length, UTF-8 and active flag; checked invocation exits before publication on failure
implementation.optimized_bridge: Optimized task-core archive now includes String runtime support for the compiled component harness

coverage: Returned String lists and shared tails
Unicode, embedded NUL and canonical empty Strings
Mutual record/enum ownership and immutable updates
Match-returned recursive values and String indexing/slicing/concatenation
Bounds-fault cleanup and injected allocation failure
Boxed inline wrapper retains String bytes after invocation settlement and drops edges at final release
Active foreign, oversized, misbased, negative-length, noncanonical empty and invalid UTF-8 descriptors rejected
Existing numeric/Bool recursive source and String runtime regressions
qualification.format: Changed C++ ranges formatted; test files pass clang-format --dry-run --Werror; git diff --check passes

limitations: Recursive compilation units still reject collection/callable fields and record arrays
